# Attribution

This applies the literal bad-class charge from icekylinx's three-stage cover theorem to the current bit-bound composition. Srikrishnabalaji identified the charge refinement in PR461; PR464 and PR465 applied it to earlier suppliers. This is a transfer of that method, not a newly discovered fallback theorem.

DreamingOfClouds, with disclosed Claude assistance, supplied PR510's R480 nine-stage word and its exact arithmetic engines; eumemic supplied the R489 source-carrier construction and the original dead-total option. PR535's rank-four complex construction and carryover exposition belong to icekylinx, with GPT-6 Astra and Codex assistance. Original notices are preserved in inputs/. All geometry, compiler, hosting, analytic and original-paper contributions retain their attribution.
